(() => { const bins=10; const bucket = Array.from({length: bins},()=>({n:0,p:0,y:0})); yScore.forEach((p:any,i:number)=>{ const b = Math.min(bins-1, Math.floor(p*bins)); const slot:any=bucket[b]; slot.n++; slot.p+=p; slot.y+=yTrue[i]; }); let e=0,t=0; bucket.forEach((b:any)=>{ if(b.n>0){ const ap=b.p/b.n, ay=b.y/b.n; e+=b.n*Math.abs(ap-ay); t+=b.n; } }); return t? e/t : 0 })
